summary: Reduce to the bound of amplitudeAbs_lt_top_and_cut_le for T = G(E), s = 1: the nonzero terms of Σ_γ |cutBessel(γg)| are, after translating by one rational δ with the level condition, terms β_c(γ⁻¹y)|W(γ⁻¹y)| of that bounded sum.

steps.claim: Take the bound M from amplitudeAbs_lt_top_and_cut_le (first part, T = all rational points, c, s = 1).
steps.lean:
((amplitudeAbs_lt_top_and_cut_le .univ a.1 1).1 _).1.imp fun _ h g ↦ by
  choose! δ d using
    @id (∃ γ, (S.h a.1)⁻¹ * (S.ratToFin γ * (S.inclHFin η * X.finiteEquiv g.2)) ∈ S.principalLevel)
  grw [← h (S.ratToInf δ * X.realHomeo g.1), ← ((Equiv.divLeft δ).symm.trans X.ratEquiv.1).tsum_eq,
    ← tsum_subtype_eq_of_support_subset]; gcongr; all_goals simp [cutBessel_ratEquiv_mul, -map_mul,
    besselFn]
  split; grw [← real_smul, enorm_toReal_smul_le]; simp [enorm]; grw [nnnorm_apply_le]; simp
  use fun _ _ e _ _ ↦ (mul_mem (d ⟨_, e⟩) (inv_mem e)).imp (by simp)

steps.claim: If some rational δ satisfies the level condition h_c⁻¹(δ ι(η) finiteEquiv(g_f)) ∈ K(g), choose it.
steps.lean:
choose! δ d using
    @id (∃ γ, (S.h a.1)⁻¹ * (S.ratToFin γ * (S.inclHFin η * X.finiteEquiv g.2)) ∈ S.principalLevel)

steps.claim: Bound Σ_{γ∈Γ} by the sum of M-bounded terms at y = δ_∞·realHomeo(g_∞), reindexing γ ↦ δ·γ⁻¹ through ratEquiv and restricting to the support.
steps.lean:
grw [← h (S.ratToInf δ * X.realHomeo g.1), ← ((Equiv.divLeft δ).symm.trans X.ratEquiv.1).tsum_eq,
    ← tsum_subtype_eq_of_support_subset]; gcongr; all_goals simp [cutBessel_ratEquiv_mul, -map_mul,
    besselFn]

steps.claim: Termwise: |β·W_i| ≤ β·∏_v‖W_v‖ (a coordinate is bounded by the norm).
steps.lean: split; grw [← real_smul, enorm_toReal_smul_le]; simp [enorm]; grw [nnnorm_apply_le]; simp

steps.claim: The support condition: a term is nonzero only if γ⁻¹δ… satisfies the level condition, which places it among the terms over (c, 1, c).
steps.lean: use fun _ _ e _ _ ↦ (mul_mem (d ⟨_, e⟩) (inv_mem e)).imp (by simp)
